description: This file defines the EmpContractDecorator class, which serves as a decorator for the EmpContract entity. It provides additional methods for retrieving formatted start and end dates, fetching contract attachments, and associating an employee by employee number within the context of a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmpContractDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that extends the functionality of EmpContract entity, providing methods for date formatting, retrieving contract attachments, and associating employees.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpContract instance.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmploymentContractService instance used for contract-related operations.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the contract.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the contract.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the contract attachment for the employee associated with the contract.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the contract based on employee number.
